base.$description: Default hover and state changes, spotlight open.

slow.$description: Sidebar open and close, notch roll.

reveal.$description: Site scroll reveals (app/(site)/_components/Reveal.tsx): a section fades and rises in once, and each item after the first waits one stagger step more.

window-open.$description: Window motion (open, close, zoom, minimize), macOS style: a quick settle with a soft end. The page behind a window that opens over it is dimmed and softly blurred.

window-minimize.$description: Window minimize: it shrinks toward the dock icon. GB components/window/motion.ts MIN_MS.

window-zoom.$description: Window zoom, a FLIP to and from full screen. GB components/window/motion.ts ZOOM_MS.

toast-enter.$description: Toast enter. GB st-toast-in runs on duration.medium.

toast-exit.$description: Toast exit. The source has no exit animation; the Toast CSS uses duration.base.

roll.$description: Desk label roll, light colour change, dock lift.

pulse.$description: One loop of a status pulse. Three loops end before five seconds (SC 2.2.2).

spring-soft.$description: Settle time of the soft spring: a reveal that eases in with no overshoot. Order 1.22, proposed.

spring-snappy.$description: Settle time of the snappy spring: a control answering a press or a toggle. Order 1.22, proposed.

spring-bouncy.$description: Settle time of the bouncy spring: a mark, a badge or a popover that lands with an overshoot. Order 1.22, proposed.

morph.$description: One beat of a morph: a stateful button or an icon that changes shape from parts. Order 1.22, proposed.

celebrate.$description: The one time beat when progress completes or a value is confirmed. Order 1.22, proposed.

peek-hide.$description: Grace period before peek chrome rolls away. Hover intent timing, not motion: kept under reduced motion.

feedback.$description: How long a short result (copied, failed) stays before the control returns to rest. Timing, not motion: kept under reduced motion.

stagger.$description: Step between the parts of a staggered group (a title, a body, actions; the rows of a list). Capped at six steps in code. Order 1.22, proposed.

default.$description: The CSS ease keyword as a curve.

out.$description: The CSS ease-out keyword as a curve.

in.$description: The CSS ease-in keyword as a curve.

reveal.$description: Scroll reveals and the hero headline: a long ease out that settles softly.

window.$description: Window open, close, zoom and minimize. A quick settle with a soft end.

spring-soft.$description: The soft spring as a CSS linear() curve. Play it over duration.spring-soft. Order 1.22, proposed.

spring-snappy.$description: The snappy spring as a CSS linear() curve. Play it over duration.spring-snappy. Order 1.22, proposed.

spring-bouncy.$description: The bouncy spring as a CSS linear() curve, with an overshoot. Play it over duration.spring-bouncy. Order 1.22, proposed.

stiffness.$description: Press scale on a control. Stiff, settles fast. No source value; set for the contract.
Sheets and drawers moving between detents. No source value; set for the contract.
Shapes that merge and split, a softer settle. No source value; set for the contract.
Soft spring, no overshoot. Order 1.22, proposed.
Snappy spring, a small overshoot. Order 1.22, proposed.
Bouncy spring, the largest overshoot of a style. Order 1.22, proposed.

nudge.$description: Travel of a hover nudge: an end arrow or a chevron that leans toward its action. Order 1.22, proposed.

shift.$description: Travel of a label, helper or error line that slides into place. Order 1.22, proposed.

enter.$description: Travel of overlay content (title, body, actions) as it staggers in. Order 1.22, proposed.

lift.$description: How far a card or tile rises under the pointer. Order 1.22, proposed.
